title: Keith McArthur:
title_short: Keith McArthur · Blue Glasses for Carter
headline: CureGRIN’s CEO tells the room why the foundation’s mascot wears blue glasses: a boy named Carter, his charming smile, and the 30 people the community has lost. Then the line that turns it hopeful: the work you do can literally be saving lives.
story: Keith McArthur gave a lunch talk to the GRIN Therapeutics team on 8 Oct, one camera, wide on the room. In the middle of it he tells the story of Carter, the son of co-founder Lauren Williams, who passed away just over three years ago, known for his charming smile and his blue sunglasses. CureGRIN’s mascot wears blue glasses in his honor. Then the stakes: of the whole patient community, 30 people have died of conditions related to GRIN disorder. Then the turn: the work you do can literally be saving lives.

For donors and partners. The loss is one line each and the cut moves to the mascot and the hope. Hopeful, never somber. No drug name, no trial name, no dates. Never a hint that a cure is near or that anyone is at fault.

This is a different cut from the hero 13277146397, which uses the “30 individuals” line and “saving lives” as its WHY IT MATTERS beat at 01:30. This short is the Carter story: it opens on the sunglasses and the mascot, never on the number, and the hero’s opening (“you are my heroes”) stays out of it.

Loops: L1 “Why blue glasses?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:16 (“in honor of Carter”). L2 “What are the glasses for?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“can literally be saving lives”). Stakes: 30 people lost in a community of hundreds.

If the slide on the TV shows Carter or the mascot when he says it, cut to a tight crop of the slide with the Zoom tile out of frame. Check on scrub.

Do not open on “30 individuals” or on “saving lives”. Those lines are the hero’s beat (13277146397). Here they are the stakes and the button, never the hook.
No drug name, no trial name, no dates. Never say or show that a cure is near, that GRIN disorders can be prevented, or that anyone is at fault.
No number on screen. The 30 stays in the captions only.

Never use the words “find your hive”.
